jobs.title: Air Quality Technical Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description

There’s no pledge more important than the one we make to look after our environment, and we’re committed to helping you do exactly that.

Join us as we strive to ensure a sustainable future for our communities and the world we live in.

Become part of our global network of skilled engineers, scientists, auditors, planners and environmental specialists, all working together to leave this world better than we found it. Who are we looking for?

To drive continued growth of our Environment Market, GHD is seeking an Air Quality Technical and Marketing/Growth Leader
to be based out of our Houston, Texas office. This is a technical and business development leadership role and will primarily support GHD’s Environment Market step-up program while representing the region as part of the National Air Quality Practice, including business planning, delivery, and support. Initial focus will be on the upstream and midstream Oil and Gas industry as well as the petrochemical industry along the Gulf Coast and Central region of the US.

In addition, the position will support growing external industry awareness and strengthen GHD’s reputation as a leader in the industry. Building from strong market and business development knowledge, this role will lead and drive creative ways to help the US air quality and compliance practice grow and maintain market leadership. Beyond the US market, this role will collaborate closely with our Technical Services across the Americas to bring the best of GHD to our clients and the markets.

In the problem-solving business, it helps to be restlessly curious to deliver community change.

Our vision is to ensure energy, water and urbanization are made sustainable for generations to come. You can lead the way into a new future for our industry, inspiring the next generation of driven and committed people in the process.

Learn About Leadership Opportunities With GHD.

Working with an energetic and high performing team, this position offers a variety of work and will see you involved in:

Assist in supporting the growth of our US air compliance practice through technical leadership with a focus in the US Central Region on upstream and midstream Oil and Gas and petrochemical clients.

What you will bring to the team:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or Environmental Engineering or other applicable degree.
Minimum 8-10 years of prior experience in the air quality and compliance and EHS compliance market preferably in the consulting business.
Upstream and Midstream Oil & Gas industry experience is preferred
Demonstrated combination of market facing and technical delivery experience
Client exposure and/or relationships in the private sector, public sector, and federal sector
Excellent interpersonal and communications skills, ability to lead pursuits and projects and interact with key internal and external stakeholders
A focus on driving cultural evolution and ways of working to enable a high-performing, agile, and entrepreneurial team
Agile self-starter with a proactive, strategic, and creative approach
Solid organizational skills with the proven ability to manage multiple priorities at a time

If you’re interested in pursuing this opportunity, please submit your application below!

As a multicultural organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of a diverse workforce. GHD is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, genetic information, national origin, sex (including same sex), sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, age, disability or handicap, citizenship status, service member status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Environmental Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Responsibilities Job Summary: Oversees and supports compliance with environmental regulations and laws within the organization. Develops and implements environmental policies and procedures, conducts audits to assess compliance, and provides training to partners on environmental regulations. Works to minimize the environmental impact of the organization's operations and ensures that all activities are in line with environmental standards. Key Responsibilities & Essential Functions: Conducts environmental audits of H-E-B facilities and store. Develops and revises audit checklists. Develops and updates SOPs and BMPs. Develops training materials for one-on-one and/or group training. Conducts training classes and one-on-one training. Collects data and prepares regulatory reports as directed. Assists in responses to environmental emergencies. Represents H-E-B at meetings of various environmental stakeholders. Develops and manages programs/projects to meet environmental compliance needs, improve environmental performance, or resolve non-compliance issues. The responsibilities and essential functions outlined above describe the general nature and level of work assigned to this position. This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Duties and responsibilities may be modified at any time based on business needs. Employees may be required to perform other job-related tasks as requested by their supervisor, subject to reasonable accommodations. Qualifications & Key Requirements: Career individual contributor in a professional role. Works independently, receiving general instructions on new assignments, and a review of outcomes for technical soundness. Applies a broad range of theories, concepts, principles, and methodologies to assignments containing some elements of complexity. Majority of work is spent both independently planning and completing the design, implementation, and/or delivery of processes, programs, and/or policies. May coach, direct, oversee, or review the work of lower-level professionals. Networks with more senior internal and external stakeholders who may be unfamiliar with the area of specialty. Work Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in environmental permitting, compliance, and regulatory support activities across multiple media programs, including air, water, waste, and related environmental compliance requirements. Experience supporting environmental permitting, regulatory compliance, inspections, audits, reporting, corrective actions, and stakeholder engagement within industrial, construction, and/or commercial settings. Experience supporting stormwater, wastewater, air permitting, hazardous waste management, spill prevention, environmental due diligence, and environmental management systems is strongly preferred. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: Demonstrated knowledge and practical experience with federal, state, and local environmental regulations is required, including the Clean Water Act (CWA), Clean Air Act (CAA), and Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA). Effective written and verbal communication skills Works well in a team environment Highly efficient in working in data management platforms and presentation software Education: Bachelor's Degree or additional role-relevant experience Licenses/Certifications: Physical Demands & Working Conditions: Function in a fast-paced, office environment Travel by car or plane with overnight stays Work extended hours; sit for extended periods. Occasionally lift 20 lbs or more The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Partner encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Last revised: 11/5/2026
